tips.title: Brake before the bend
tips.tip: Ease off the gas before a corner, then speed up on the way out. You'll be quicker than if you slam the brakes halfway through.

tips.title: Find your favourite ride
tips.tip: Every car handles differently. Sports cars grip well, while big trucks and vans are slow to turn. Try a few and see which one suits you.

tips.title: Race smart
tips.tip: Keep an eye on the checkpoints and the map. Knowing where the next turn is matters more than top speed. Crashed? Get straight back on track and stay calm.

tips.title: Mod shop upgrades
tips.tip: At the mod shop you can change paint and wheels, and upgrade the engine, brakes and tyres. Spend your in-game money on the car you drive most.

tips.title: Road trip!
tips.tip: The map is huge. Try driving to the mountains, the beach or the countryside just for the views. And save your game often so you don't lose progress.

tips.title: Stay safe online 🛡️
tips.tip: Never share your password, full name, school, address or phone number, even with game 'friends'. If someone is mean or weird, block and report them, then tell Dad.

tips.title: No such thing as free Robux
tips.tip: Anyone offering 'free Robux' or asking for your password is trying to scam you. Only buy things from the official Roblox store or inside the game.

tips.title: Obby jumping
tips.tip: Line up your jump first by moving the camera so you can see your feet. Run and jump right at the edge of the platform. Slow and steady beats rushing!

tips.title: Studio starter
tips.tip: Roblox Studio is free and lets you make your own games. Start with simple parts, shape them with the Move, Scale and Rotate tools, and press Play to test often.

tips.title: Anchor it!
tips.tip: In Studio, 'Anchor' any part that shouldn't move, otherwise it will fall or tumble when you press Play. Ready for more? Roblox games are coded in Lua (Luau).

tips.title: The four builds
tips.tip: The basic builds are wall, floor, stairs (ramp) and roof (cone). Practise switching between them fast. Creative mode is perfect for practising with no pressure.

tips.title: Pick your material
tips.tip: Wood builds fastest but is weakest. Brick is in the middle. Metal is slowest to build but toughest once it's finished.

tips.title: Beat the storm
tips.tip: Watch the storm timer on your map and start moving toward the safe zone early. Rushing at the last second is risky. Collect materials along the way.

tips.title: Edit like a pro
tips.tip: Editing lets you add windows, doors and arches to your builds. Practise edits in Creative until they feel quick and smooth.

tips.title: Make your own island
tips.tip: In Creative you can build a race track, a parkour course or even a basketball court. Try other players' parkour maps to improve your movement.

tips.title: Look ahead, not at your bumper
tips.tip: When you're racing or cruising, keep your eyes a few corners ahead on the mini-map. Spotting the next turn early means you can brake smooth and keep more speed.

tips.title: Camera is your friend
tips.tip: In most Roblox games, hold right-click (or use the right stick) to look around while you move. Seeing what's coming helps a lot in parkour and adventures.

tips.title: Land with a plan
tips.tip: Before you jump from the Battle Bus, pick a spot on the map. Quiet edges often mean easier loot and time to gear up before you meet other players.

tips.title: Smooth braking beats slamming
tips.tip: Ease off the accelerator before a corner, then brake gently. Slamming the brakes locks the wheels and you slide past the turn. Smooth in, fast out!

tips.title: Shift lock for precision
tips.tip: In many Roblox games, turn on Shift Lock (or first-person) so you turn with the camera. It makes parkour jumps and aiming feel much tighter.

tips.title: Listen before you peek
tips.tip: Sound tells you a lot — footsteps, chests, and builds. Pause for a second near a building and listen before you rush in.
